summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 41/41 PASS (100%) — added TestChecklist (5 tests), TestPush (2 tests), and augmented TestVisits to assert visit.room_name is populated on POST and returned by GET /api/visits?teacher_id=. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844) — every requested user-facing change works: (1) PINCH-ONLY ZOOM: zoom-in-btn/zoom-out-btn are absent from the DOM and the 'Pinch to zoom' hint renders (count=1). No double-tap zoom code path remains. (2) BUILDING RENAME FIX (bug): Admin signed in with 'gobigred' -> opened manage-building-btn -> typed into 'building-name-input' -> tapped 'save-building-name' -> header picker text updated from 'Memorial Hall' to 'TEST_UIRename' after closing the sheet. Rename persists across GET /api/buildings and reflects in header (put-buildings test also passes). Reset name to 'Memorial Hall' to leave DB clean. (3) ROOM CHECKLIST (new): opened a room; 5 default checklist items rendered under testIDs check-<uuid>; toggling flipped done state; 'checklist-input' + 'checklist-add' successfully added 'TEST_UI_Item' (visible in list, count=1). Backend endpoints POST/DELETE /rooms/{id}/checklist and POST /rooms/{id}/checklist/toggle all return the updated room and every seeded room already carries a non-empty checklist. (4) TEACHER CALENDAR (bug fix): Ms. Nguyen sees the Calendar tab. Booking calendar in RoomSheet: dates <3 days ahead are locked, tapped cal-2026-08-14 (+3 days) -> room flips to teacher_in (red) -> POST /rooms/{id}/visit returns toggled='added' with room_name populated. Calendar tab shows 1 visit-card-<id> with cancel-visit-<id>; cancel toggles the booking off (0 cards after). (5) PUSH (best-effort): POST /api/register-push exists (returns 500 in preview due to placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY — expected, not a bug). Chat POST /conversations/{id}/messages still succeeds (200) and message is persisted — push failures are non-blocking as required. (6) REGRESSION: role-based tabs verified — Admin={Floor Plan,Numbers,Contest}, Teacher={Floor Plan,Numbers,Calendar,Contest}, Boss={Floor Plan,Numbers,Chats,Contest}, Cleaner={Floor Plan,Numbers,Chats,Contest}. Cleaner does NOT see manage-building-btn (gear is admin-only). Deprecated packages detected: none. Only carried-over non-blocking RN Web warnings ('shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents) remain — same as iteration 1 & 2.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py register_push: raises 500 when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY placeholder returns 401 — the message is 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid'. That's fine for preview but I confirmed chat send is truly non-blocking (send_push wrapped in try in _notify_conversation).

server.py add_visit stores room_name at write time (denormalized). If a room is renamed later, existing visit rows will show the old name. Acceptable trade-off for this app; flag only if product requires live sync.
make_checklist uses DEFAULT_CHECKLISTS keyed by room type and falls back to 'room' — good.
PUT /api/buildings/{id} still lacks auth check (matches iteration 1/2 lightweight-auth style, per main-agent context).
